Hello and welcome to "Thin Green Line" another template by me!
Anyone who knows me by now will know that I love plain templates which
offer a lot of whitespace and maybe one or two features which make it
stand out. In this template, that feature would be the use of animated gifs.
Sure, they're regarded as horrible things but I think they can be used quite
nicely, as I have tried to demonstrate in this template.
A note on the slogan in the header: The gap between the grey line and
the slogan is adjusted in the css. If your site title is longer than "Thin Green
Line" then you may have to adjust this value!
